description: a = [1,2,3]; x = a[0]; if x then x + 1 else 0 end : Int. The simplest possible narrowing rung and the right first one: the desugared condition is a bare `var local x`, so no aliasing and no new PrimSig row are involved. Array#[] gives `nilable Int` (correctly -- an out-of-range index is nil), and `nilable Int` matches no arithmetic row, so the then-branch must see `x : Int` or nothing types. Note the shape of the obligation: truthiness excludes *both* nil and false, so narrowing `nilable T` on a truthy test is sound for any T that is not Bool -- and for `nilable Bool` it would have to keep `false`.
